tooltip.enchantment_library.library: Stores enchantments; keeps its contents when broken.
message.enchantment_library.failed: Check the available points, level, item, enchantment conflicts and output space.
gui.enchantment_library.pinyin_enabled: JECh pinyin search enabled. Search by name or ID. Right-click to clear.
gui.enchantment_library.pinyin_optional: Search by name or ID. Install Just Enough Characters for pinyin search. Right-click to clear.
gui.enchantment_library.conversion: I = 1 point, II = 2, III = 4; each level doubles.
gui.enchantment_library.store_help: Extract all enchantments, including curses. The clean item is returned in the output slot.
gui.enchantment_library.enchant_help: Apply all checked enchantments at their individual slider levels. Conflicts or insufficient points cancel the entire operation; upgrades charge only the difference.
gui.enchantment_library.withdraw_help: Put ordinary books in the middle slot. All checked enchantments are written to one book, consuming one ordinary book and their point costs.
gui.enchantment_library.select_help: Check multiple enchantments, then apply them together. Changing a slider also checks its enchantment.
gui.enchantment_library.slider_help: Level %s / %s. Drag to choose a level; arrow keys adjust by one, or five with Shift.
gui.enchantment_library.batch_help: Selections are kept while searching and scrolling. The entire selection is applied in one operation.
gui.enchantment_library.deposit_slot: Insert an enchanted book or equipment to extract its enchantments.
gui.enchantment_library.target_slot: Insert equipment to enchant, or ordinary books to withdraw enchanted books.
gui.enchantment_library.output_slot: Clean equipment, returned books and withdrawn enchanted books appear here.
